title: Capture why across session handoffs
narrative: Handoffs preserve goals, exclusions, completed/pending work, decisions, rationale, rejected alternatives, risks, evidence, an expected verdict, and next action — hosts store the record. Accepts WalkingLabs L05 guidance[^wl-l05-handoff]. Maps to personal-agent MH-PA-04[^insp-pa-04]: goals, exclusions, evidence, risks, and verdict are first-class. Also the typed handoff seam for Dots MH-DOTS-07[^insp-dots-07-handoff] (`fangore_insp_cross_task_isolation`).
implementation: `HandoffRecord` in `mechaharness.handoff_record` is the reusable schema (typed `goals`, `exclusions`, and `verdict` fields); storage remains host-owned. `CrossTaskIsolationGuard.share` consumes `evidence_refs` as the explicit sharing path.
validation: Kind `handoff_record_fields`. Hard expects next_action, goals, exclusions, and verdict kind round-tripped as typed fields.
